files.description: B10 EHI export documentation — 3-page PDF describing the on-demand patient data export via the Practice Patient Data web portal. Documents export to PDF format covering demographics, allergies, medications, diagnoses, visit notes, and vitals. Includes screenshots of the export interface and a sample exported record. This is the primary b(10) artifact.
files.curl_command: curl -sL 'http://www.mdrhythm.com/MDRhythm%20B10%20Data%20Export%20Instructions.pdf' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0' -o 'MDRhythm B10 Data Export Instructions.pdf'

files.description: FHIR API documentation — 240-page PDF covering the g(10) standardized API (US Core 5.0.1, SMART App Launch 2.0.0, Bulk Data 2.0.0). Documents FHIR R4 resources with full request/response examples. This is g(10) documentation, not b(10), but included for completeness as it's linked on the same compliance page.
The ONC compliance page HTML — the registered CHPL documentation URL. Contains disclosure statement, price transparency, links to RWT plans, FHIR API docs, and B10 export docs.
Full-page browser screenshot of the ONC compliance page showing the page layout, certification logos, disclosure text, and links to both the FHIR API and B10 export documentation PDFs.
